title: Aa Mere Asghar
body:
Aa Mere Asghar
Aa Mere Asghar
(Aa mere Asghar) x6
<<DIVIDER>>
Jula julawu lori sunawu (aa mere asghar)x3
(Teri judai maar gayi hai maa ki umide tute gayi hai)x2
maaki umide tut gayi hai
tujko jo pawu dil se lagawu
<<MINI>>
aa mere asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
(Kaise sahu ye zakhme judayi teer se tune pyaas bujayi)x2
teer se tune pyaas bujayi
ashk pilawu pyaas bujawu
<<MINI>>
aa mere asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
(Milbhi gaya agar pani meri jaan kaise piyengi Bali Sakina)x2
kaise piyengi Bali Sakina
pani jo pawu tujko pilawu
<<MINI>>
aa mere asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
(Tuhi bata ay mere gule tar dhund kaha ye madare muztar)x2
dhund kaha ye madare muztar
maidan me awu darya pe jawu
<<MINI>>
aa mere asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
(Koi kushi ab raas nahi hai lakhte jigar jo paas nahi hai)x2
lakhte jigar jo paas nahi hai
paas bulawu neer bahawu
<<MINI>>
aa mere asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
(Saye me kaise jayengi madar teri lahad hai dhup me Asghar)x2
teri lahad hai dhup me Asghar
saye me jawu mai marna jawu
<<MINI>>
aa mere asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
(Koi kushi ka din bhi na aya laal mere tu khun me nahaya) x2
laal mere tu khun me nahaya
khaima sajawu mannat barawu
<<MINI>>
aa mere asghar
